name: Embarrassed Silence
description: Combining see-no-evil and speak-no-evil monkeys to express embarrassment and staying quiet about it.
meaning: Used when something embarrassing happened that you don't want to see or talk about. Cute way to acknowledge awkwardness.
examples: That typo in my work email 🙈🙊
seoTitle: 🙈🙊 See No Evil Speak No Evil Combo Meaning
seoDescription: What does 🙈🙊 mean? The see-no-evil and speak-no-evil combo explained. Used for embarrassing moments you'd rather forget.
